desc.id: Serabut pendek yang kuat di antara sisi basis os metacarpi bersebelahan yang saling berhadapan, tepat di distal faset sendinya yang kecil.

attach.en: Rough adjacent surfaces of the bases of metacarpals II to V.
attach.id: Permukaan kasar yang saling berhadapan pada basis os metacarpi II sampai V.

function.en: Main bond between the metacarpal bases.
function.id: Pengikat utama antar-basis ossa metacarpi.

desc.en: Loose fibrous capsules around each metacarpophalangeal joint, at the knuckles.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa yang longgar di sekeliling setiap articulatio metacarpophalangea, di daerah buku-buku jari.

attach.en: Margins of the head of the metacarpal and the base of the proximal phalanx. The sides are thickened by the collateral ligaments and the palmar side by the palmar ligament (palmar plate).
attach.id: Tepi caput os metacarpi dan basis phalanx proximalis. Sisi-sisinya menebal oleh ligamenta collateralia dan sisi palmarnya oleh lig. palmare (lempeng palmar).

function.en: Enclose the joints. On the dorsal side the capsule is thin and is covered and reinforced by the extensor expansion.
function.id: Membungkus sendi. Di sisi dorsal capsula tipis serta ditutupi dan diperkuat oleh aponeurosis dorsalis (extensor expansion).

clinical.en: In rheumatoid arthritis the synovium of these joints swells early, and the stretched capsules and ligaments let the fingers drift toward the ulnar side.
clinical.id: Pada artritis reumatoid, membrana synovialis sendi ini membengkak sejak awal, dan capsula serta ligamen yang teregang membuat jari-jari bergeser ke arah ulnar (deviasi ulnar).

desc.en: Strong cords on each side of every metacarpophalangeal joint, running obliquely distally and toward the palm from the metacarpal head to the proximal phalanx.
desc.id: Tali-tali kuat di kedua sisi setiap articulatio metacarpophalangea, berjalan miring ke distal dan ke arah palmar dari caput os metacarpi ke phalanx proximalis.

attach.en: Tubercle and pit on the side of the metacarpal head, dorsal to its centre, to the side of the base of the proximal phalanx; an accessory fan-shaped part reaches the palmar plate.
attach.id: Tuberculum dan cekungan pada sisi caput os metacarpi, di dorsal titik pusatnya, ke sisi basis phalanx proximalis; bagian aksesorius yang berbentuk kipas mencapai lempeng palmar.

function.en: Limit sideways movement. The metacarpal head is wider on its palmar side and the ligaments attach dorsal to its centre, so they are slack in extension and tight in flexion; the fingers can therefore be spread only when these joints are extended.
function.id: Membatasi gerak ke samping. Caput os metacarpi lebih lebar di sisi palmar dan ligamen melekat di dorsal titik pusatnya, sehingga ligamen kendur saat ekstensi dan tegang saat fleksi; karena itu jari-jari hanya dapat diregangkan bila sendi ini dalam posisi ekstensi.

clinical.en: A hand that must be immobilised is splinted with these joints flexed, so the ligaments stay long and do not stiffen. A tear of the ulnar collateral ligament of the thumb is skier's (gamekeeper's) thumb.
clinical.id: Tangan yang harus diimobilisasi dibidai dengan sendi ini dalam posisi fleksi agar ligamen tetap panjang dan tidak menjadi kaku. Robekan ligamentum collaterale ulnare ibu jari disebut skier's thumb (gamekeeper's thumb).

desc.en: Three short bands that join the palmar ligaments (plates) of the metacarpophalangeal joints of fingers II to V. The thumb is not included, so the first metacarpal stays free to move.
desc.id: Tiga pita pendek yang menghubungkan ligamenta palmaria (lempeng palmar) articulatio metacarpophalangea jari II sampai V. Ibu jari tidak termasuk, sehingga os metacarpi I tetap bebas bergerak.

attach.en: Palmar plates of adjacent metacarpophalangeal joints of digits II to V, across the palmar surfaces of the metacarpal heads.
attach.id: Lempeng palmar articulatio metacarpophalangea yang bersebelahan pada jari II sampai V, melintang di permukaan palmar capita ossium metacarpi.

function.en: Ties the heads of metacarpals II to V together and limits their spreading. The interossei pass dorsal to it, while the lumbricals and the digital vessels and nerves pass palmar to it.
function.id: Mengikat capita ossium metacarpi II sampai V satu sama lain dan membatasi pelebarannya. Mm. interossei lewat di dorsalnya, sedangkan mm. lumbricales serta vasa dan nervi digitales lewat di palmarnya.

la: Capsulae articulares articulationum interphalangearum proximalium manus
en: Articular capsules of proximal interphalangeal joints of hand

desc.en: Fibrous capsules of the joints between the proximal and middle phalanges of fingers II to V.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa sendi-sendi antara phalanx proximalis dan phalanx media jari tangan II sampai V.

attach.en: Margins of the head of the proximal phalanx and the base of the middle phalanx; reinforced at the sides by the collateral ligaments and on the palmar side by the palmar ligament.
attach.id: Tepi caput phalanx proximalis dan basis phalanx media; diperkuat di kedua sisi oleh ligamenta collateralia dan di sisi palmar oleh lig. palmare.

function.en: Enclose the joints. On the dorsal side the central slip of the extensor expansion covers the capsule and inserts on the base of the middle phalanx.
function.id: Membungkus sendi. Di sisi dorsal, pita tengah (central slip) aponeurosis dorsalis menutupi capsula dan berinsersio pada basis phalanx media.

clinical.en: Rupture of the central slip lets the joint push up through the extensor hood, giving a boutonniere deformity. Bony swellings of these joints in osteoarthritis are Bouchard nodes.
clinical.id: Putusnya central slip membuat sendi menonjol melalui aponeurosis dorsalis sehingga timbul deformitas boutonniere. Benjolan tulang pada sendi ini akibat osteoartritis disebut nodus Bouchard.

la: Capsulae articulares articulationum interphalangearum distalium manus
en: Articular capsules of distal interphalangeal joints of hand

desc.en: Fibrous capsules of the joints between the middle and distal phalanges of fingers II to V. The single interphalangeal joint of the thumb has a similar capsule.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa sendi-sendi antara phalanx media dan phalanx distalis jari tangan II sampai V. Satu-satunya articulatio interphalangea ibu jari memiliki capsula yang serupa.

attach.en: Margins of the head of the middle phalanx and the base of the distal phalanx; reinforced by the collateral and palmar ligaments.
attach.id: Tepi caput phalanx media dan basis phalanx distalis; diperkuat oleh ligamenta collateralia dan palmaria.

function.en: Enclose the joints. The terminal tendon of the extensor expansion covers the dorsal side and inserts on the base of the distal phalanx.
function.id: Membungkus sendi. Tendo terminal aponeurosis dorsalis menutupi sisi dorsal dan berinsersio pada basis phalanx distalis.

clinical.en: Avulsion of the terminal extensor tendon leaves the fingertip drooping (mallet finger). Bony swellings of these joints in osteoarthritis are Heberden nodes.
clinical.id: Lepasnya tendo extensor terminal membuat ujung jari terkulai (mallet finger). Benjolan tulang pada sendi ini akibat osteoartritis disebut nodus Heberden.

en: Collateral ligaments of interphalangeal joints of hand

desc.en: Cords on both sides of each interphalangeal joint of the fingers and thumb.
desc.id: Tali-tali di kedua sisi setiap articulatio interphalangea jari tangan dan ibu jari.

attach.en: Sides of the head of the more proximal phalanx to the sides of the base of the next phalanx; accessory fibres fan out to the palmar ligament.
attach.id: Sisi caput phalanx yang lebih proksimal ke sisi basis phalanx berikutnya; serabut aksesorius menyebar ke lig. palmare.

function.en: Prevent sideways movement, so the interphalangeal joints work as hinges.
function.id: Mencegah gerak ke samping sehingga articulationes interphalangeae bekerja sebagai engsel.

clinical.en: A sideways force on a finger, common in ball sports, often sprains or tears the collateral ligament of a proximal interphalangeal joint.
clinical.id: Gaya dari samping pada jari, yang sering terjadi pada olahraga bola, kerap menyebabkan terkilir atau robeknya ligamentum collaterale articulatio interphalangea proximalis.

en: Palmar ligaments (plates) of interphalangeal joints of hand

desc.en: Thick fibrocartilaginous plates on the palmar side of the interphalangeal joints of the hand, often called volar plates.
desc.id: Lempeng fibrocartilago yang tebal di sisi palmar articulationes interphalangeae tangan, sering disebut volar plate.

attach.en: Firmly to the base of the more distal phalanx and loosely to the head and neck of the more proximal one; the collateral ligaments and the fibrous digital sheath attach to their edges.
attach.id: Melekat erat pada basis phalanx yang lebih distal dan longgar pada caput dan collum phalanx yang lebih proksimal; ligamenta collateralia dan vagina fibrosa digitorum melekat pada tepinya.

function.en: Prevent hyperextension and give the long flexor tendons a smooth surface to glide over.
function.id: Mencegah hiperekstensi dan memberi permukaan licin bagi tendo fleksor panjang untuk meluncur.

clinical.en: Forced hyperextension of a proximal interphalangeal joint can tear the plate or pull off a small fragment of the middle phalanx; a lax plate allows a swan-neck deformity.
clinical.id: Hiperekstensi paksa pada articulatio interphalangea proximalis dapat merobek lempeng ini atau menarik lepas fragmen kecil dari phalanx media; lempeng yang kendur memungkinkan terjadinya deformitas swan-neck.
